intro.title: La Saladita, Guerrero — not Sayulita
intro.sayulita: Welcome to the home of one of Mexico's longest left-hand points. Small town, warm water, zero pretension.
intro.water: Tropical warm water (29–31°C). Rashguard or lycra for sun — no wetsuit needed.
intro.season: Best swell: May–October (south swell season). Quieter months: November–April.

tips.accordion.cash.title: Cash & ATMs
tips.accordion.cash.body: No ATM in town — withdraw in Zihuatanejo or Troncones. Keep small bills for tacos and taxis.
tips.accordion.signal.title: Phone signal
tips.accordion.signal.body: Telcel/AT&T work but coverage is spotty on the beach road. Hacienda Café WiFi is the most reliable in town.
tips.accordion.roads.title: Getting around
tips.accordion.roads.body: Unpaved sections after rain — go slow. Sedan is fine with care; high-clearance helps.
tips.accordion.groceries.title: Groceries & basics
tips.accordion.groceries.body: Hacienda Café has essentials. Full shop at Mega/Soriana in Zihuatanejo on your way in.
tips.accordion.respect.title: Local respect
tips.accordion.respect.body: Small fishing and surf community — quiet at night, respect the lineup, ask before photographing people.
